---
title: "AP-MS interaction scoring, isoform specificity and network annotation"
output: html_document
---

## Purpose

Affinity-purification mass spectrometry (AP-MS) was performed on 13 pairs of CAD
sQTL-derived protein isoforms (26 3xFLAG-tagged baits) plus RAB11B, GFP and bead
controls in HEK293T cells. Bait–prey pairs were scored independently with CompPASS and
SAINTexpress; this script applies the thresholds given in Methods to each scorer,
retains only preys that pass both (the high-confidence set), removes self-hits, and
labels every prey of a bait pair as risk-specific, nonrisk-specific or shared according
to which isoform(s) it passed the thresholds with. Each prey is then annotated with
VSMC expression support (Human Protein Atlas smooth-muscle-cell set, VSMC discovery
proteomics and VSMC long-read transcriptome), prior evidence in BioGRID and membership
in the Aragam et al. (2022) CAD GWAS causal-gene list, and the result is exported as the
master network used by every downstream AP-MS analysis and by Cytoscape. A final
section runs the control checks reported in Results: RAB11B positive-control recovery
and replicate consistency, GFP/bead negative-control pass-through, and recovery of
known partners from BioGRID.

## Manuscript outputs produced

- Methods, "Interaction scoring and network annotation" (thresholds, specificity
  definition, BioGRID / HPA / VSMC annotation).
- Results, "Isoform-resolved AP-MS reveals extensive rewiring…": 601 high-confidence
  interactions, 496 (83 %) detected with one isoform, mean 46 per pair; RAB11B control
  recovery; GFP/bead pass-through; known-partner recovery; 36 of 601 interactions in
  BioGRID (Fig. 5e).
- Inputs to Fig. 5b–h and Extended Data Fig. 7 (drawn in `10_figure_and_table_generation`
  and Cytoscape), Supplementary Table 17 (via script 10) and the GO enrichment of script 08.

## Inputs

- `F_SAINT_SET`, `F_COMPPASS_SET` — SAINTexpress and CompPASS output for the three
  experimental sets (deposited search results, PRIDE).
- `F_HPA_SMC_GENES` — Human Protein Atlas genes expressed in smooth muscle cells.
- `F_SMC_SPECIFICITY_MANUAL` — manual VSMC-expression check (discovery proteomics and
  long-read transcriptome) for the preys absent from the HPA set.
- `F_ARAGAM_S31_GENES` — most likely causal CAD genes, Aragam et al. 2022 Supp. Table 31.
- `F_BIOGRID_TAB3` — BioGRID 5.0.252, Homo sapiens, tab3 format.

## Outputs (all in `RES_07`)

- `saint_combined.tsv` — the three SAINT sets concatenated (background for the recovery
  analysis).
- `MASTER_network_LFC.csv` — Cytoscape edge table: bait gene, prey, log2 PSM fold change,
  specificity, PSM per isoform, BioGRID flag.
- `master_network_full_annotated.csv` — the edge table with harmonised gene names, the
  Aragam CAD-gene flag and Cytoscape helper columns; read by scripts 08, 09 and 10.
- `combined_shared_full_annot_summary.csv` — per bait × prey VSMC support flags (Fig. 5b,
  Supplementary Table 17).
- `CAD_APMS_long_summary.csv`, `CAD_APMS_wide_summary.csv` — interactions per pair and
  specificity class (Results numbers; Fig. 5d).
- Control checks: `rab11b_high_confidence_interactions.tsv`,
  `rab11b_replicate_consistency.csv`, `rab11b_control_biogrid_human_apms_overlap.csv`,
  `known_partner_recovery_per_gene.csv`, `known_partner_recovery_summary.csv`,
  `shared_vs_specific_known_fisher.csv`.

## Run order

Independent of scripts 01–06 (it reads only AP-MS and public inputs); must run before
08, 09 and 10.

# 1. Setup

```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
source("config.R")
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
ensure_dir(RES_07)
require_files(F_SAINT_SET, F_COMPPASS_SET, F_HPA_SMC_GENES, F_SMC_SPECIFICITY_MANUAL,
              F_ARAGAM_S31_GENES, F_BIOGRID_TAB3)

CTRL_BAIT <- "RAB11B-3xFLAG"   # positive-control bait; not a CAD sQTL locus

# Strip the isoform suffix from a bait or prey label to obtain the gene symbol
# (e.g. "ITGA1-PB5448-10" -> "ITGA1", "PARP12_PB_8076_5" -> "PARP12"), used to
# remove self-hits and to compare bait genes with prey genes.
first_gene <- function(x) str_remove(x, "[-_].*")
```

# 2. The 13 risk/nonrisk bait pairs

Bait labels in the SAINT and CompPASS output encode gene and PacBio accession
(`GENE-PB<gene>-<isoform>`). The pair table is defined once here so that specificity,
fold changes and the network share one source of truth. The CFDP1 (RP11-77K12.1) risk
bait PB.14782.8 is listed for completeness but is absent from the scoring output
(the construct yielded no scorable pulldown), so CFDP1 contributes nonrisk-bait
interactions only.

```{r bait_pairs}
isoform_pairs <- tibble(
  risk = c("FAAP20-PB-52-18", "SRP54-PB-13005-14", "SLC9A3R2-PB14193-3", "DPYD-PB866-1",
           "COA8-PB-13446-1", "NOB1-PB-14720-2", "ADAMTS7-PB13964-5", "LDLR-PB-16511-5",
           "MLX-PB-15434-2", "RP11-77K12-1-PB-14782-8", "TRIM5-PB-10574-10",
           "ITGA1-PB5448-10", "PARP12-PB8076-1"),
  nonrisk = c("FAAP20-PB-52-24", "SRP54-PB-13005-1", "SLC9A3R2-PB14193-1", "DPYD-PB866-2",
              "COA8-PB-13446-9", "NOB1-PB-14720-9", "ADAMTS7-PB13964-7", "LDLR-PB-16511-1",
              "MLX-PB-15434-10", "RP11-77K12-1-PB-14782-7", "TRIM5-PB-10574-4",
              "ITGA1-PB5448-2", "PARP12-PB8076-5")
) %>%
  mutate(gene      = sub("-PB.*$", "", risk),
         gene_pair = paste0(gene, "_vs_", sub("-PB.*$", "", nonrisk)))

# one row per bait, with its role in the pair
iso_bait_long <- isoform_pairs %>%
  select(gene_pair, risk, nonrisk) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(risk, nonrisk), names_to = "bait_type", values_to = "Bait")

# Symbols under which a bait gene may appear in BioGRID (older or alternative HGNC
# symbols). Used for the BioGRID edge flag and for the known-partner recovery below.
BAIT_ALIASES <- list(
  "SLC9A3R2"     = c("NHERF2"),
  "RP11-77K12-1" = c("CFDP1", "RP11-77K12.1"),
  "RP11-77K12.1" = c("CFDP1", "RP11-77K12-1"),
  "COA8"         = c("APOPT1", "C14orf153", "APOP1", "APOP", "APOP-1", "MC4DN17", "MGC2562"),
  "FAAP20"       = c("C1ORF86")
)
alias_set <- function(g) unique(toupper(str_trim(c(g, BAIT_ALIASES[[g]]))))
```

# 3. Scoring output and thresholds

CompPASS and SAINTexpress were run separately on each of the three experimental sets;
the sets are concatenated before filtering because thresholds are absolute. The
thresholds are those stated in Methods: CompPASS WD-score ≥ 1, Z-score ≥ 1.2,
entropy > 0.75 and mean PSM ≥ 2; SAINT score ≥ 0.8, Bayesian FDR ≤ 0.05, fold change
over controls ≥ 5 and mean spectral count ≥ 2. Self-hits (prey gene equal to the bait
gene) are removed on both sides.

```{r load_scores}
saint    <- map_dfr(F_SAINT_SET,    read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
comppass <- map_dfr(F_COMPPASS_SET, read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
write_tsv(saint, OUT_SAINT_COMBINED)

comppass_filtered <- comppass %>%
  filter(Z >= 1.2 & Entropy > 0.75 & WD >= 1 & AvePSM >= 2) %>%
  filter(sub("-.*", "", Bait) != Prey)

saint_filtered <- saint %>%
  filter(SaintScore >= 0.8 & BFDR <= 0.05 & FoldChange >= 5 & AvgSpec >= 2) %>%
  filter(sub("-.*", "", Bait) != PreyGene)

# second, stricter self-hit removal at the gene level (handles "_"-separated labels)
saint2 <- saint_filtered %>%
  mutate(bait_gene = first_gene(Bait), prey_gene = first_gene(PreyGene)) %>%
  filter(bait_gene != prey_gene) %>%
  select(-bait_gene, -prey_gene)

comp2 <- comppass_filtered %>%
  mutate(bait_gene = first_gene(Bait), prey_gene = first_gene(Prey)) %>%
  filter(bait_gene != prey_gene) %>%
  select(-bait_gene, -prey_gene)
```

# 4. High-confidence set: CompPASS ∩ SAINT

Only bait–prey pairs passing both scorers are retained. Each side is reduced to one row
per (bait, prey) before the metadata are joined, so the final table has exactly one row
per high-confidence interaction.

```{r intersect_scores}
saint_pairs <- saint2 %>%
  transmute(Bait, Prey = PreyGene) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Bait, Prey), ~ trimws(.))) %>%
  distinct()
comp_pairs <- comp2 %>%
  transmute(Bait, Prey) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Bait, Prey), ~ trimws(.))) %>%
  distinct()

shared_pairs <- inner_join(saint_pairs, comp_pairs, by = c("Bait", "Prey"))
n_shared <- nrow(shared_pairs)

saint_one_row <- saint2 %>%
  group_by(Bait, PreyGene) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ dplyr::first(.x)), .groups = "drop")
comp_one_row <- comp2 %>%
  group_by(Bait, Prey) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ dplyr::first(.x)), .groups = "drop")

saint_shared    <- saint_one_row %>% semi_join(shared_pairs, by = c("Bait", "PreyGene" = "Prey"))
comppass_shared <- comp_one_row  %>% semi_join(shared_pairs, by = c("Bait", "Prey"))
stopifnot(nrow(saint_shared) == n_shared, nrow(comppass_shared) == n_shared)

# SAINT columns first, CompPASS metrics (WD, Z, Entropy, AvePSM) appended
combined_shared_full <- left_join(saint_shared, comppass_shared,
                                  by = c("Bait" = "Bait", "PreyGene" = "Prey"))
message(sprintf("%d high-confidence bait-prey pairs across %d baits (controls included)",
                nrow(combined_shared_full), n_distinct(combined_shared_full$Bait)))

# RAB11B positive-control preys, used by the Controls section and by script 10
combined_shared_full %>%
  filter(Bait == CTRL_BAIT) %>%
  write_tsv(file.path(RES_07, "rab11b_high_confidence_interactions.tsv"))
```

# 5. Isoform specificity

Within each bait pair, a prey is *shared* if it passed the thresholds with both the risk
and the nonrisk bait, and *risk-* or *nonrisk-specific* if it passed with only one of
them. Specificity therefore reflects passing the threshold, not absence from the other
pulldown. The control bait has no pair, so its specificity is undefined (NA).

```{r specificity}
missing_baits <- anti_join(iso_bait_long, distinct(combined_shared_full, Bait), by = "Bait")
if (nrow(missing_baits) > 0)
  message("Bait(s) without high-confidence interactions: ",
          paste(unique(missing_baits$Bait), collapse = ", "))

combined_tagged <- combined_shared_full %>%
  select(-any_of(c("gene_pair", "bait_type"))) %>%
  left_join(iso_bait_long, by = "Bait")

specificity_flags <- combined_tagged %>%
  filter(!is.na(bait_type)) %>%
  group_by(gene_pair, PreyGene) %>%
  summarise(has_risk    = any(bait_type == "risk"),
            has_nonrisk = any(bait_type == "nonrisk"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(specificity = case_when(
    has_risk & has_nonrisk  ~ "shared",
    has_risk & !has_nonrisk ~ "risk-specific",
    !has_risk & has_nonrisk ~ "nonrisk-specific",
    TRUE                    ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  select(gene_pair, PreyGene, specificity)

combined_shared_full_annot <- combined_tagged %>%
  left_join(specificity_flags, by = c("gene_pair", "PreyGene"))
```

# 6. Log2 PSM fold change (risk versus nonrisk)

For every prey of a pair, the mean PSM in the risk pulldowns is compared with that in
the nonrisk pulldowns as log2((PSM_risk + 1) / (PSM_nonrisk + 1)); a prey not passing
with one isoform contributes 0 on that side. This value shades the prey nodes in
Extended Data Fig. 7 and is reported in Supplementary Table 17.

```{r psm_fold_change}
shared_wide <- combined_shared_full_annot %>%
  select(gene_pair, Prey, bait_type, AvePSM) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = bait_type, values_from = AvePSM, values_fill = 0) %>%
  rename(PSM_risk = risk, PSM_nonrisk = nonrisk)

all_PSM_LFC <- shared_wide %>%
  mutate(log2FC_PSM = log2((PSM_risk + 1) / (PSM_nonrisk + 1))) %>%
  left_join(combined_shared_full_annot, join_by(gene_pair == gene_pair, Prey == PreyGene)) %>%
  select(gene_pair, Prey, PSM_risk, PSM_nonrisk, log2FC_PSM, specificity)
```

# 7. VSMC expression support for the interactors

Because the pulldowns were performed in HEK293T cells, each prey is checked for
expression in VSMCs from three sources: the HPA smooth-muscle-cell expression set, the
VSMC discovery proteomics data and the VSMC long-read transcriptome. Preys absent from
the HPA set were looked up manually in the latter two datasets
(`F_SMC_SPECIFICITY_MANUAL`); preys present in HPA are taken as supported by all three.

```{r vsmc_support}
hpa_smc <- read_tsv(F_HPA_SMC_GENES, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(Gene, `Gene description`)
smc_specificity <- read_csv(F_SMC_SPECIFICITY_MANUAL, show_col_types = FALSE)

combined_shared_full_annot <- combined_shared_full_annot %>%
  left_join(hpa_smc, join_by(PreyGene == Gene)) %>%
  mutate(In_SMCs_in_HPA = if_else(!is.na(`Gene description`), "YES", "NO")) %>%
  left_join(smc_specificity, by = "PreyGene") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c("SMC Protein", "SMC LR RNAseq")), ~ replace_na(.x, "YES")))

combined_shared_full_annot_summary <- combined_shared_full_annot %>%
  mutate(specificity = forcats::fct_infreq(as.factor(specificity)),
         gene_pair   = as.factor(gene_pair))

# per bait x prey support flags (Fig. 5b; Supplementary Table 17)
combined_shared_full_annot_summary %>%
  select(Bait, PreyGene, specificity, In_SMCs_in_HPA, `SMC Protein`, `SMC LR RNAseq`) %>%
  write_excel_csv(OUT_PREY_VSMC_SUPPORT)
```

# 8. Interaction counts per pair

Counts of risk-specific, shared and nonrisk-specific interactions per bait pair give
the totals quoted in Results and the proportions shown in Fig. 5d.

```{r pair_summaries}
sum_long <- combined_shared_full_annot_summary %>%
  count(gene_pair, specificity, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(gene_pair) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n), pct = n / total) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(gene_pair, specificity)

sum_wide <- sum_long %>%
  select(-pct) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = specificity, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(row_total = sum(c_across(where(is.numeric)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(gene_pair)

write_csv(sum_long, OUT_APMS_LONG_SUMMARY)
write_csv(sum_wide, OUT_APMS_WIDE_SUMMARY)

# numbers for the text (CAD baits only; the control bait has no specificity)
apms_cad <- combined_shared_full_annot_summary %>% filter(!Bait %in% CTRL_BAIT)
apms_cad %>%
  summarise(interactions = n(), distinct_prey = n_distinct(PreyGene),
            baits = n_distinct(Bait)) %>%
  print()
print(count(apms_cad, specificity))
combined_shared_full_annot_summary %>%
  distinct(PreyGene, In_SMCs_in_HPA, `SMC Protein`, `SMC LR RNAseq`) %>%
  mutate(any_support = In_SMCs_in_HPA == "YES" | `SMC Protein` == "YES" |
                       `SMC LR RNAseq` == "YES") %>%
  count(any_support, name = "n_prey") %>%
  print()
```

# 9. BioGRID prior evidence

BioGRID 5.0.252 (human) is loaded once with the columns needed here and in the
Controls section. Prior evidence for each high-confidence interaction is assessed at the
gene level: every BioGRID record in which Official Symbol Interactor A or B equals the
bait gene (or one of its alternative symbols) is collected, the partners from both
columns are pooled, self-interactions are removed, and a prey is flagged `in_biogrid`
when it is among its bait gene's partners. Matching is case-insensitive.

```{r biogrid_load}
bg_cols <- c("Entrez Gene Interactor A", "Entrez Gene Interactor B",
             "Official Symbol Interactor A", "Official Symbol Interactor B",
             "Synonyms Interactor A", "Synonyms Interactor B",
             "Organism ID Interactor A", "Organism ID Interactor B",
             "Experimental System", "Experimental System Type", "Publication Source")
bg <- fread(F_BIOGRID_TAB3, sep = "\t", quote = "", select = bg_cols,
            showProgress = FALSE) %>% as_tibble()

bg_sym <- bg %>%
  transmute(symA = toupper(`Official Symbol Interactor A`),
            symB = toupper(`Official Symbol Interactor B`))

# gene-level BioGRID partner set per bait gene
biogrid_partners <- function(gene) {
  syms <- alias_set(gene)
  hits <- bg_sym %>% filter(symA %in% syms | symB %in% syms)
  setdiff(unique(c(hits$symA, hits$symB)), syms)
}
bait_partner_sets <- set_names(unique(isoform_pairs$gene)) %>% map(biogrid_partners)
```

# 10. Master network for Cytoscape

One edge per bait gene → prey with the fold change, specificity and PSM values; preys
lacking VSMC support in all three sources are removed, as stated in Methods. The
`in_biogrid` flag is appended here, and the table is written as the Cytoscape input.

```{r master_network_lfc}
master_pre <- combined_shared_full_annot %>%
  left_join(shared_wide, join_by(gene_pair == gene_pair, Prey == Prey)) %>%
  mutate(log2FC_PSM = log2((PSM_risk + 1) / (PSM_nonrisk + 1)))

# The VSMC support flags are prey-level attributes already carried by every row
# (section 7), so the filter is applied to them directly.
master_network <- master_pre %>%
  mutate(`Gene Name Source` = sub("_vs_.*$", "", gene_pair),
         `Gene Name Target` = Prey,
         Interaction        = "Interaction",
         weight             = abs(log2FC_PSM)) %>%
  filter(!(In_SMCs_in_HPA == "NO" & `SMC Protein` == "NO" & `SMC LR RNAseq` == "NO")) %>%
  select(`Gene Name Source`, `Gene Name Target`, log2FC_PSM, weight, specificity,
         PSM_risk, PSM_nonrisk, Interaction)

in_bg <- function(bait_gene, prey) {
  if (is.na(bait_gene) || is.null(bait_partner_sets[[bait_gene]])) return("NO")
  if_else(toupper(prey) %in% bait_partner_sets[[bait_gene]], "YES", "NO")
}
master_network <- master_network %>%
  mutate(in_biogrid = map2_chr(`Gene Name Source`, `Gene Name Target`, in_bg))

# shared preys are stored once per bait of the pair; count each bait-prey edge once
edge_bg <- master_network %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Gene Name Source`)) %>%
  distinct(`Gene Name Source`, `Gene Name Target`, .keep_all = TRUE)
message(sprintf("%d of %d high-confidence CAD-bait interactions are annotated in BioGRID",
                sum(edge_bg$in_biogrid == "YES"), nrow(edge_bg)))
write_csv(master_network, OUT_MASTER_NETWORK_LFC)
```

# 11. Annotated master network

Gene symbols are harmonised to the names used for GO lookups in the network figures
(display names in tables and panels are produced downstream with `display_gene()`),
preys encoded by independent CAD GWAS loci are flagged from the Aragam et al. (2022)
causal-gene list (black outlines in Extended Data Fig. 7), and three duplicate columns
are added because Cytoscape styles map one column to one visual property.

```{r master_network_annotated}
cad_gwas_aragam <- read_csv(F_ARAGAM_S31_GENES, show_col_types = FALSE)

master_network <- master_network %>%
  mutate(
    source_harmonized = case_when(`Gene Name Source` == "RP11-77K12-1" ~ "CFDP1",
                                  `Gene Name Source` == "SLC9A3R2"     ~ "NHERF2",
                                  TRUE ~ `Gene Name Source`),
    target_harmonized = case_when(`Gene Name Target` == "C1orf112" ~ "FIRRM",
                                  TRUE ~ `Gene Name Target`),
    in_cad_gwas_aragam_2022 = if_else(
      `Gene Name Target` %in% cad_gwas_aragam$most_likely_causal_gene, "YES", "NO"),
    specificity_target = specificity,       # node colour for prey (Cytoscape)
    in_biogrid_edge    = in_biogrid,        # edge style (Cytoscape)
    source_for_target  = `Gene Name Source` # bait assignment per prey node (Cytoscape)
  )

write_csv(master_network, OUT_MASTER_NETWORK_ANNOT)
```

# 12. Controls

## 12.1 RAB11B positive control: recovery and replicate consistency

Per-replicate spectral counts are stored as `a|b|c`; a prey is consistently recovered
if it has counts in every bait replicate run.

```{r rab11b_recovery}
rab_shared <- combined_shared_full %>% filter(Bait == CTRL_BAIT)

rab_rep <- rab_shared %>%
  transmute(PreyGene,
            NumReplicates = suppressWarnings(as.integer(NumReplicates)),
            spec_vec      = str_split(as.character(Spec), "\\|")) %>%
  mutate(spec_vec   = map(spec_vec, ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))),
         n_reps_obs = map_int(spec_vec, ~ sum(.x > 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
         n_reps_str = map_int(spec_vec, ~ sum(!is.na(.x))),
         n_reps_tot = coalesce(NumReplicates, n_reps_str),
         all_reps   = n_reps_obs == n_reps_tot & n_reps_tot > 0)
if (any(rab_rep$n_reps_str != rab_rep$n_reps_tot))
  warning("Spec length differs from NumReplicates for some RAB11B preys")

saint_set <- unique(saint2$PreyGene[saint2$Bait == CTRL_BAIT])
comp_set  <- unique(comp2$Prey[comp2$Bait == CTRL_BAIT])
n_rab     <- length(unique(rab_shared$PreyGene))
cat(sprintf("RAB11B high-confidence preys (SAINT and CompPASS): %d\n", n_rab),
    sprintf("  passing SAINT: %d | passing CompPASS: %d\n", length(saint_set), length(comp_set)),
    sprintf("  detected in all replicates: %d of %d\n", sum(rab_rep$all_reps), n_rab), sep = "")

rab_rep %>%
  mutate(Spec = map_chr(spec_vec, ~ paste(.x, collapse = "|"))) %>%
  select(-spec_vec) %>%
  write_csv(file.path(RES_07, "rab11b_replicate_consistency.csv"))
```

## 12.2 RAB11B preys previously reported by human AP-MS

Human–human Affinity Capture-MS records involving RAB11B are taken from BioGRID using the
Entrez identifier (9230), because symbol matching alone would also pick up rodent Rab11b
and RAB43 records.

```{r rab11b_biogrid}
CTRL_GENE <- "RAB11B"
CTRL_ENT  <- "9230"

ctrl_hits <- bg %>%
  filter(`Experimental System` == "Affinity Capture-MS",
         `Organism ID Interactor A` == 9606, `Organism ID Interactor B` == 9606,
         `Entrez Gene Interactor A` == CTRL_ENT | `Entrez Gene Interactor B` == CTRL_ENT)
ctrl_partner <- toupper(ifelse(ctrl_hits$`Entrez Gene Interactor A` == CTRL_ENT,
                               ctrl_hits$`Official Symbol Interactor B`,
                               ctrl_hits$`Official Symbol Interactor A`))
bg_apms <- setdiff(unique(ctrl_partner), CTRL_GENE)

rab_preys  <- rab_shared %>%
  mutate(prey = toupper(first_gene(PreyGene))) %>% pull(prey) %>% unique()
n_prior_ms <- sum(rab_preys %in% bg_apms)
cat(sprintf("RAB11B: %d preys; %d previously reported by human AP-MS (%d BioGRID publications)\n",
            length(rab_preys), n_prior_ms, n_distinct(ctrl_hits$`Publication Source`)))

rab_overlap <- tibble(prey = rab_preys) %>%
  left_join(tibble(prey = ctrl_partner, pub = ctrl_hits$`Publication Source`) %>%
              group_by(prey) %>%
              summarise(n_pubs = n_distinct(pub), pubs = paste(unique(pub), collapse = ";"),
                        .groups = "drop"),
            by = "prey") %>%
  mutate(in_biogrid_human_apms = !is.na(n_pubs), n_pubs = coalesce(n_pubs, 0L)) %>%
  arrange(desc(in_biogrid_human_apms), prey)
write_csv(rab_overlap, file.path(RES_07, "rab11b_control_biogrid_human_apms_overlap.csv"))
```

## 12.3 GFP and bead negative controls

GFP-transfected and bead-only pulldowns are the SAINT control set; this check asks how
many of their preys would pass the CompPASS thresholds on their own and whether any such
prey survives in the final network.

```{r negative_controls}
GFP_BAITS <- comppass %>% distinct(Bait) %>%
  filter(str_detect(toupper(Bait), "GFP")) %>% pull(Bait)
stopifnot(length(GFP_BAITS) > 0)

cp_pass <- comppass_filtered %>%
  count(Bait, name = "n_pass") %>%
  right_join(comppass %>% distinct(Bait), by = "Bait") %>%
  mutate(n_pass = coalesce(n_pass, 0L),
         type = case_when(Bait %in% c(GFP_BAITS, "beads") ~ "negative control",
                          Bait == CTRL_BAIT                ~ "positive control",
                          TRUE                             ~ "isoform bait"))
cp_pass %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  summarise(n_baits = n(), median_pass = median(n_pass), min_pass = min(n_pass),
            max_pass = max(n_pass), .groups = "drop") %>%
  print()

# network edges at the gene level (CAD baits only), used here and in 12.4
spec_side <- function(s) case_when(
  grepl("non", s, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("risk", s, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "nonrisk",
  grepl("shared|both", s, ignore.case = TRUE)                                ~ "shared",
  grepl("risk", s, ignore.case = TRUE)                                       ~ "risk",
  TRUE                                                                       ~ "other")
mn2 <- master_network %>%
  transmute(bait = `Gene Name Source`, prey = `Gene Name Target`, sc = spec_side(specificity)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(prey), prey != "", bait != CTRL_GENE) %>%
  distinct()

# control-passing preys (GFP protein itself excluded) that remain in the final network
ctrl_prey <- comppass_filtered %>%
  filter(Bait %in% c(GFP_BAITS, "beads")) %>%
  distinct(Prey) %>%
  mutate(Prey = toupper(Prey)) %>%
  filter(Prey != "EGFP")
retained <- mn2 %>%
  mutate(prey_u = toupper(prey)) %>%
  filter(prey_u %in% ctrl_prey$Prey) %>%
  distinct(bait, prey_u, sc)
message(sprintf("%d control-passing preys; %d retained network edges involve one of them",
                nrow(ctrl_prey), nrow(retained)))
```

## 12.4 Recovery of known partners from BioGRID

For each bait gene and for RAB11B, the high-confidence preys are compared with the
partners reported by human Affinity Capture-MS in BioGRID (any direction) and with the
subset reported by BioPlex with the gene as bait. Expected recovery is computed against
the background of every prey gene detected in any unfiltered pulldown, giving precision,
recall and fold enrichment per gene. Shared and isoform-specific preys are then compared
for prior BioGRID evidence (Fisher's exact test), with sensitivity analyses excluding
CFDP1 and the bead-flagged preys.

```{r known_partner_recovery}
BIOPLEX_PMIDS <- c("PUBMED:26186194", "PUBMED:28514442", "PUBMED:33961781")

bg_h <- bg %>%
  filter(`Experimental System` == "Affinity Capture-MS",
         `Organism ID Interactor A` == 9606, `Organism ID Interactor B` == 9606) %>%
  transmute(symA = toupper(`Official Symbol Interactor A`),
            symB = toupper(`Official Symbol Interactor B`),
            pmid = `Publication Source`)
ref_long <- bind_rows(
  bg_h %>% transmute(sym = symA, partner = symB, pmid, dir = "bait"),
  bg_h %>% transmute(sym = symB, partner = symA, pmid, dir = "prey"))

# observed gene-level preys: CAD baits plus the RAB11B control
obs <- bind_rows(
  mn2 %>% transmute(gene = bait, prey = toupper(prey), sc),
  rab_shared %>% transmute(gene = CTRL_GENE, prey = toupper(first_gene(PreyGene)), sc = "control")
) %>% filter(sc != "other") %>% distinct()

# bait gene -> BioGRID official symbol(s)
bait_syms <- tibble(gene = unique(obs$gene)) %>%
  mutate(sym = map(gene, alias_set)) %>% unnest(sym) %>%
  semi_join(ref_long, by = "sym")
stopifnot(all(c("FAAP20", "RP11-77K12-1") %in% bait_syms$gene))

ref_all <- bait_syms %>%
  inner_join(ref_long, by = "sym", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(partner != sym) %>%
  distinct(gene, partner, pmid, dir)
ref_sets <- list(
  "human AP-MS, any direction" = ref_all %>% distinct(gene, partner),
  "BioPlex, gene as bait"      = ref_all %>% filter(dir == "bait", pmid %in% BIOPLEX_PMIDS) %>%
                                   distinct(gene, partner))

# background: every prey gene detected in any unfiltered pulldown
bg_prot <- saint %>% transmute(p = toupper(first_gene(PreyGene))) %>% pull(p) %>% unique()
N_bg    <- length(bg_prot)

recovery <- imap_dfr(ref_sets, function(ref, label) {
  obs_g <- obs %>% distinct(gene, prey)
  obs_g %>% count(gene, name = "n_preys") %>%
    left_join(ref %>% count(gene, name = "n_known"), by = "gene") %>%
    left_join(ref %>% filter(partner %in% bg_prot) %>% count(gene, name = "n_known_bg"),
              by = "gene") %>%
    left_join(obs_g %>% semi_join(ref, by = c("gene", "prey" = "partner")) %>%
                count(gene, name = "n_recovered"), by = "gene") %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with("n_"), ~ coalesce(.x, 0L)),
           expected  = n_preys * n_known_bg / N_bg,
           precision = n_recovered / n_preys,
           recall    = if_else(n_known > 0, n_recovered / n_known, NA_real_),
           reference = label,
           group     = if_else(gene == CTRL_GENE, "RAB11B control", "CAD baits"))
})

summary_tbl <- recovery %>%
  group_by(reference, group) %>%
  summarise(genes           = n(),
            genes_with_ref  = sum(n_known > 0),
            preys           = sum(n_preys),
            known_partners  = sum(n_known),
            recovered       = sum(n_recovered),
            precision_pct   = 100 * recovered / preys,
            recall_pct      = 100 * sum(n_recovered[n_known > 0]) / sum(n_known),
            expected        = sum(expected),
            fold_enrichment = recovered / expected,
            p_approx        = ppois(recovered - 1, expected, lower.tail = FALSE),
            .groups = "drop")
print(summary_tbl, width = Inf)

# Shared versus isoform-specific preys: prior BioGRID evidence (CAD baits only). The
# primary test uses the same gene-level `in_biogrid` flag as Fig. 5e and Supplementary
# Table 17 (any physical BioGRID record for the bait gene), so that the count of
# annotated interactions and the enrichment statistic in the text share one definition.
# The human AP-MS-restricted reference set used for the recovery analysis above is kept
# as a sensitivity analysis.
run_fisher <- function(d, label) {
  ft <- fisher.test(table(d$class, d$known))
  d %>% group_by(class) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), n_known = sum(known), pct_known = 100 * mean(known), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(analysis = label, odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate),
           ci_low = ft$conf.int[1], ci_high = ft$conf.int[2], p = ft$p.value)
}

spec_biogrid <- edge_bg %>%
  transmute(gene  = `Gene Name Source`, prey = `Gene Name Target`,
            class = if_else(specificity == "shared", "shared", "isoform-specific"),
            known = in_biogrid == "YES")

spec_apms <- obs %>%
  filter(gene != CTRL_GENE) %>%
  mutate(class = if_else(sc == "shared", "shared", "isoform-specific")) %>%
  distinct(gene, prey, class) %>%
  left_join(ref_sets[["human AP-MS, any direction"]] %>% mutate(known = TRUE),
            by = c("gene", "prey" = "partner")) %>%
  mutate(known = coalesce(known, FALSE))
flagged <- retained %>% transmute(gene = bait, prey = prey_u)

spec_results <- bind_rows(
  run_fisher(spec_biogrid, "any BioGRID physical record (Fig. 5e definition)"),
  run_fisher(spec_apms, "human AP-MS records only"),
  run_fisher(spec_apms %>% filter(gene != "RP11-77K12-1"),
             "human AP-MS records only, excl. CFDP1 (RP11-77K12.1)"),
  run_fisher(spec_apms %>% anti_join(flagged, by = c("gene", "prey")),
             "human AP-MS records only, excl. bead-flagged"))
print(spec_results, width = Inf)

write_csv(recovery,     file.path(RES_07, "known_partner_recovery_per_gene.csv"))
write_csv(summary_tbl,  file.path(RES_07, "known_partner_recovery_summary.csv"))
write_csv(spec_results, file.path(RES_07, "shared_vs_specific_known_fisher.csv"))
```
